def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    points = np.empty((n_runs, 60, 3), dtype=float)
    points[:, 0, :2] = start
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0
    # The hypothesis is the hiker stays put at a sheltered spot just below 2450m ridgeline on lee (NE) side.
    # We try to move walkers from start to close to elevation 2400-2450m, slightly NE of ridgeline (~bearing 45°),
    # then stay there (no movement).
    # We try one move at t=dt, then stay still.
    # Calculate ridgeline elevation approx 2450m and aim at elevation 2410-2440m near ridgeline, 
    # on lee (NE, bearings 0-90°). Assume slightly NE offset from start.
    # We do a single move: offset along bearing 45°, distance chosen so elev close to ~2420-2440m, before staying put.
    
    dt = duration_s / 59
    points[:, 1:, 2] = np.linspace(dt, duration_s, 59)
    
    lat = np.full(n_runs, start[0])
    lon = np.full(n_runs, start[1])
    
    # Generate candidate offsets along bearing 45°
    bearing = np.pi/4
    dist_max = 200  # m max offset to find sheltered spot
    
    # Candidate distances: linearly spaced 0 to 200m
    dists = np.linspace(0, dist_max, 40)
    
    # For each run find the dist giving elev between 2400-2450m and slope < 15 deg near
    # the NE lee side (slope low implies sheltered)
    dists_all = np.tile(dists, (n_runs,1))  # shape (n_runs,40)
    bearing_all = np.full_like(dists_all, bearing)
    lat_off, lon_off = terrain.offset(np.repeat(lat,40), np.repeat(lon,40),
                                      np.repeat(bearing, n_runs*40), dists_all.ravel())
    lat_off = lat_off.reshape(n_runs,40)
    lon_off = lon_off.reshape(n_runs,40)
    elevs = terrain.elev(lat_off, lon_off)
    slopes = terrain.slope_deg(lat_off, lon_off)
    
    # Conditions: elev between 2400-2450, slope < 15
    cond = (elevs >= 2400) & (elevs <= 2450) & (slopes < 15)
    
    # For each run, pick the minimal dist satisfying cond, else zero dist (stay put)
    valid_idx = np.where(cond, np.arange(40), 40)
    min_idx = valid_idx.min(axis=1)
    move_dist = np.where(min_idx<40, dists[min_idx], 0)
    
    # Compute final pos at t=1 step
    lat1, lon1 = terrain.offset(lat, lon, bearing, move_dist)
    
    # Clamp inside bounds
    lat1c, lon1c = terrain.clamp(lat1, lon1)
    
    # Set positions at step 1
    points[:, 1, 0] = lat1c
    points[:, 1, 1] = lon1c
    # Steps 2..59 same position (stay put)
    points[:, 2:, 0] = lat1c[:,None]
    points[:, 2:, 1] = lon1c[:,None]
    
    # Check inside terrain box all points
    inside_all = terrain.inside(points[:,:,0], points[:,:,1])
    ok = inside_all.all(axis=1)
    
    return points, ok

hypothesis.description: Sat at a sheltered area just below the ridgeline on the lee (northeast) side to avoid wind exposure.
hypothesis.rationale: Ridges, especially at 2450 m elevation, can be windy; a sheltered area just below the crest offers protection.
